items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: So he had this show, and he would bring all of these gospel people in, and the union required them to have one union musician, so I was the musician.

ctx.x: Yeah, right. And I had -- well, like, gospel music. I did, on Channel 26 here, they had a gospel show -- and Gate mouth Moore. I don't know, do you remember him? He was a blues singer at one time, then he turned to be a minister.

So he had this show, and he would bring all of these gospel people in, and the union required them to have one union musician, so I was the musician. And then they brought their own organ player and piano player and I'd have to get the length of the tunes and all that straightened out with them and everything.
